title: fix: mark judgement unrateable when LLM API returns a non-JSON 200 body

files.patch:
@@ -80,5 +80,9 @@ def post envelope
 
     body = response.body
     body.is_a?(String) ? JSON.parse(body) : body
+  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
+    # A 200 that is not JSON (an HTML error page from a proxy, a truncated body)
+    # is an API failure like any other, so callers' RuntimeError handling applies.
+    raise "LLM API Error: response was not valid JSON (#{e.message})"
   end
 end

@@ -137,6 +137,21 @@ class LlmServiceTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
       end
     end
 
+    test 'a 200 response whose body is not JSON marks the judgement unrateable instead of raising' do
+      [ '<html>502 Bad Gateway</html>', '{"choices": [', '' ].each do |body|
+        judgement = Judgement.new(query_doc_pair: query_doc_pair, user: judge)
+
+        stub_request(:post, 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions')
+          .with(headers: { 'Authorization' => "Bearer #{OPENAI_VALID_KEY}" })
+          .to_return(status: 200, body: body, headers: { 'Content-Type' => 'text/html' })
+
+        service.perform_safe_judgement judgement
+
+        assert judgement.unrateable, "expected body #{body.inspect} to be unrateable"
+        assert_match(/\ABOOM: Runtime Error: LLM API Error: response was not valid JSON/, judgement.explanation)
+      end
+    end
+
     test 'a numeric-looking string judgment value is still accepted' do
       judgement = Judgement.new(query_doc_pair: query_doc_pair, user: judge)
